messages:
Nora: Heads-up: We'll run a 'healthscore hydration' job at 08:00 PT tomorrow to populate missing health_score and reconcile inconsistent tags (engagement_delta vs last_seen). Also plan to add a temporary "quiet_playbook" flag to reduce noise during the job. Dry-run first 250 accounts. ETA ~50m.
Diego: Will this touch renewal_risk tags? Any chance of overwriting manual risk annotations?
Nora: We will not overwrite manual_renewal_risk. The job writes health_score, suggested_risk (internal), and adds a helper tag 'hydrated:2026-03-24' for traceability.
Anika: please paste the hydration rule set so I can sanity-check thresholds.
Nora: Rule snippet (dry-run preview):
```
-- pseudocode for score
if last_seen < now() - interval '45 days' then score = 20
elif last_seen < now() - interval '14 days' then score = 45
elif last_seen < now() - interval '3 days' then score = 70
else score = 95
-- bump +10 if admin_active_events_last_30d > 0
-- floor to 0, cap to 100
```
Nora: Tagging rules: add 'engagement:low/medium/high' based on score buckets; only add 'renewal_risk:low_engagement' if score < 40 and manual_renewal_risk IS NULL.
Diego: Important: add guard to skip accounts where opt_out_admin_mutations = true OR is_test_account = true. Also skip accounts with renewal_status = 'renewed'.
Nora: Added guards. Update will be batched by owner_id to limit blast radius. We'll snapshot to cs_admin.backups.hydration_1890012345 before mutating.
Anika: How are we muting playbooks? We still need some critical runbooks to fire (billing alerts, security).
Nora: Plan: set runner tag quiet_playbook=true for targeted owners only (not global). That flag is read by playbook runner; critical playbooks explicitly bypass it. We'll add a note to the runbook that critical ones are allowed.
platform-bot: Job scheduled: CS-9123 "healthscore-hydration + targeted quiet_playbook" by Nora for 2026-03-24T08:00PT. Dry-run ID: dr-1890012345.
Diego: Rollback plan? If we accidentally update too many rows, we need fast revert.
Nora: Rollback: restore from cs_admin.backups.hydration_1890012345 (per-owner snapshot). We'll also keep a CSV of changed ids in admin-s3/hydration/1890012345.csv and a short changelog in cs-admin/logs/hydration_1890012345.log.
Anika: Metrics to watch: playbook_fires/min, outbound_webhooks/queue_len, support_tickets/new_by_tag, and leaderboards for owners so we can detect owner-impacted churn.
Diego: I'll flip the owner-scoped quiet flag at 07:55 PT and revert at 09:00 PT unless you ask me to keep longer. I'll also monitor webhook queue.
Nora: Thanks. Dry-run will start 08:00 (first 250), then owner batches 08:10-08:50. I'll post counts for hydrated/unchanged/skipped after first owner batch. :thumbsup:
Anika: lgtm, thanks for adding the guards and owner batching.
Nora: Kicking off dry-run now (pasting sample output in 5m).
